summary: The MaintGoverningOrg module provides web-based functionality for managing governing organizations within the HSPnet system. It includes features for viewing, adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating organization records.
purpose: Manage governing organization records, including adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating them within the web application.

workflows.name: Manage Governing Organizations
steps: Add a new organization: Switch to add mode, enter details, save.
Edit an organization: Switch to edit mode based on selection, modify details, save.
Delete or reactivate based on selected record.

business_rules: A user must have SystemAdministrator rights and not be in ViewOnly mode to edit records.
Phone and fax numbers can have optional masking based on user preference.
conditions: UsePhoneMask to determine how phone numbers are validated.
system_behavior: Displays error and warning messages depending on user actions.
Handles data binding for grid and details views.
Uses panels and modal pop-ups for user interactions.
exceptions: Attempt to delete without permissions triggers error message.
